description.value: Off The Rail Brewing is an East Vancouver craft brewery with a tasting room sitting directly on the Adanac bike path, one of Vancouver's primary cycling corridors. The tasting room pours 10–12 of the brewery's own beers across 15 taps — including 3 nitro taps — and serves light food such as Jamaican patties, potato pea samosas, and grilled cheese sandwiches. The brewery also produces Bine Sparkling Hop Water, a non-alcoholic, hop-infused sparkling water for alcohol-free riders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The tasting room page explicitly states the brewery is 'proudly located on the Adanac bike path, which is well known as one of the major cycling highways in the city,' and a customer testimonial confirms window/patio visibility of cyclists ('relax with a book and watch the bikes go by'). Contact details on the website (phone 604-563-5767, address 1351 Adanac Street Vancouver BC V5L 2C4) exactly match the OSM tags. No explicit mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null.
concerns: The homepage still displays a COVID-era social distancing message ('Thank you for respecting our social distancing measures'), suggesting the front page copy has not been fully refreshed; the underlying business and news sections show activity as recently as January 2025, so this appears to be stale copy rather than a closure signal.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The brewery is explicitly situated on the Adanac bike path, actively markets itself to cyclists, offers a sit-down tasting room with food and packaged takeout beer, and is confirmed open — a strong fit for the WWC cycling tourism directory.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Tasting room page lists 'Potato pea Samosas' as a food item, which is an inherently vegetarian option. No explicit vegan or GF claims are made
